workouts.title: Drop Set
workouts.details:
2km warm up at a conversational pace (no faster than 6:40/km), 90s walking rest

2 reps of:
• 1km at 5:40/km, 90s walking rest

2 reps of:
• 800m at 5:35/km, 90s walking rest

2 reps of:
• 600m at 5:20/km, 90s walking rest

2 reps of:
• 400m at 5:15/km, 90s walking rest

2 reps of:
• 200m at 5:05/km, 90s walking rest

1km cool down at a conversational pace (or slower!)

workouts.title: Rolling 400s
workouts.details:
2km warm up at a conversational pace (no faster than 6:40/km)

Repeat the following 5x:
----------
400m at 5:40/km
400m at 6:20/km
----------

90s walking rest

1.5km cool down at a conversational pace (or slower!)

workouts.title: 9km Easy Run
workouts.details: 9km easy run at a conversational pace (no faster than 6:40/km). This is a limit, not a target - run at whatever pace feels truly easy!

workouts.title: Race Pace Practice K's
workouts.details:
2km warm up at a conversational pace (no faster than 6:55/km), keeping things easy for the majority. Within the warm up do 4 x 100m fast 'strides' aiming for around 5:30/km. 60s walking rest

4 reps of:
• 1km at 6:45/km, this is your target Half Marathon pace, 90s walking rest

1.5km cool down at a conversational pace (or slower!)
